{{Quote|Failsafe sees too much - says too much. He tells of certain past and uncertain future. His people must seal him away.|Failsafe, talking of himself in third person|<ref name="Failsafe" />}}
'''Failsafe''' was the name given to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] who lived during the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. For speaking heresies, he was placed in [[Prison/Legends|stasis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and given the express task of ensuring that the [[World Razer]] was never freed from the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world by keeping the [[Burning Way]] operational. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was consulted by a citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and informed him to activate the mechanism to entrap the World Razer before it could free itself from Belsavis.
